questions.event_title: Will a balloon be removed from the 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade?
questions.question: Will a balloon be removed from the 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade?
questions.rules:
This market will resolve to “Yes” if any qualifying balloon is removed from the route during the 2026 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, scheduled for November 28, 2026. Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

A balloon is removed if it begins the parade flown aloft but does not complete the full route of the parade, for any reason (for example, damage, deflation, wind conditions, or a directive of the NYPD or another New York City authority). A balloon that is brought down and then carried, towed or walked for the rest of the parade without being airborne will also count as removed. Changes to the parade route, whether made before or during the parade, will not by themselves count.

The following will not count: a balloon that never begins the parade (for example, one grounded beforehand or damaged during inflation); a balloon that flies at a lowered altitude but stays airborne until it finishes the parade; the planned deflation of balloons after they finish the parade; and balloons still in the parade when the entire parade is stopped and not resumed.

A qualifying balloon is any balloon listed under "Balloons" in Macy's official lineup for the 2026 parade (https://www.macys.com/s/parade/lineup/) as of this market's creation: Acorn; Billie Brightpaw; Blue Hippopotamus; Bluey; Buckaroo Bob The Minion; Buzz Lightyear; Diary Of A Wimpy Kid; Dora; Earl the Squirrel; Felix the Cat; Gabby & Pandy Paws; Goku; Goldbear; Hello Kitty; Ice Crystals; Joe Cool & Woodstock; KPop Demon Hunters: Derpy Tiger; Macy's Blue Stars; Macy's Blueprint Stars; Macy's Gold Stars; Macy's Green Stars; Macy's Red Stars; Macy's Red "Believe" Stars; Macy's Silver Star; Macy's Yellow Stars; Mario; Marshall from PAW Patrol; Noorah; PAC-MAN; Pikachu & Eevee; Poinsettia Ornaments; Pumpkins; Shrek's Onion Carriage; Smokey Bear; Sorcerer's Apprentice Mickey; Spider-Man; SpongeBob SquarePants & Gary; The Pillsbury Doughboy; and Underdog. Where a listing covers more than one balloon (for example, Macy's Red Stars or Pumpkins), the removal of any one of those balloons will count. Balloonicles, floats, inflatable elements of floats, and entries in any other section of the lineup do not qualify.

If the parade is cancelled, or does not begin by December 15, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to “No”.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

questions.question: Will PP win the most seats in Badajoz in the 2026 Spanish general election?
questions.rules:
Legislative elections to elect the 350 members of the Congress of Deputies of Spain are scheduled to take place on November 29, 2026.

This market will resolve according to the political party that wins the greatest number of seats in the Congress of Deputies of Spain in the constituency of Badajoz as a result of this election.

If the results of the specified election are not definitively known by November 30, 2027, 11:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Other".

Parties will be ranked by the number of seats won by their electoral lists (candidaturas) in the constituency of Badajoz, attributed as set out below. If two or more parties are tied on seats, ties will be broken by the total number of valid votes received by their lists in the constituency of Badajoz, with higher vote totals ranking higher. If parties remain tied, ties will be broken by alphabetical order of the listed party names. This market will resolve to the party that occupies the highest finishing position after applying this ranking.

Seats and votes will be attributed according to the electoral list on which they were obtained, as reported in the official results, regardless of the party membership of individual candidates. Lists will be attributed as follows:

PSOE: lists of the Spanish Socialist Workers' Party, including the Partit dels Socialistes de Catalunya (PSC) lists in Catalonia.

PP: lists of the People's Party, including the joint UPN–PP list in Navarre.

Broad Front (FA): all Broad Front lists, including Catalunya en Comú in Catalonia, Compromís–Valencian Front in the Valencian Community, and Canarian People’s Unity (UPC) in the Canary Islands.

ERC: Republican Left of Catalonia lists, including the joint ERC–Podem lists in Catalonia.

Podemos: only lists presented by Podemos on its own.

CCa: Canarian Coalition lists, including the joint CCa–1º CAN lists in the Canary Islands.

Any other list will be attributed to the party or coalition that presents it, as named in the official proclamation of candidacies.

Electoral cooperation, endorsements, coalition agreements, or subsequent changes in party affiliation or parliamentary-group membership will not be considered.

This market will resolve based on the results of the elections, as indicated by a consensus of credible reporting. In the case of ambiguity, this market will resolve solely based on the results as reported by the Spanish Ministry of the Interior (https://infoelectoral.interior.gob.es/).

questions.question: Will annual inflation be 3.8% in November?
questions.rules:
This is a market about inflation over the 12-month period ending November 2026, before seasonal adjustment, as reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics.

This market will resolve to the percentage change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the 12-month period ending in November 2026 according to the monthly Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) report.

The resolution source for this market will be the BLS Consumer Price Index report released for November 2026 (https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/cpi.htm), currently scheduled to be released on December 10, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. Resolution of this market will take place upon release of the aforementioned data.

Note: the resolution source for this market will be the official monthly BLS CPI news release, which reports inflation over 12-month periods to only one decimal point (e.g., 2.9%). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

If the BLS does not release the relevant figures on the scheduled date, this market may remain open up until the scheduled release time of the next CPI report (https://www.bls.gov/schedule). If the information is not released by that time, this market will resolve according to the figures of the most recent previous month with available data.

questions.question: Will the November 2026 unemployment rate be 4.1%?
questions.rules:
This market will resolve according to the seasonally adjusted unemployment rate (total unemployed, as a percent of the civilian labor force, official unemployment rate denoted as U-3) reported by the Bureau of Labor Statistics in the Employment Situation Report for November 2026.

The resolution source for this market is the Monthly Employment Situation Report, published by the BLS every month at https://www.bls.gov/bls/news-release/empsit.htm, specifically the U-3 measure in Table A-15 for the month in question.

The relevant data release is scheduled for December 4, 2026, at 8:30 AM ET. This market will resolve as soon as the relevant data is issued. Any revisions to the data after the first release will not count toward this market's resolution.

If no data for the specified month is released by the date the next month's data is scheduled to be released, this market will resolve based on data from the last available month.

Note: the resolution source for this market reports unemployment to one decimal point. Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.
